The main trial of Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu and 407 other defendants began at the courthouse complex in Silivri, in Istanbul, Turkey. Prosecutors are seeking a combined sentence of 2,430 years in prison for Imamoglu, accusing him of leading a criminal network linked to alleged corruption within the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality. Imamoglu, a senior figure in the opposition Republican People's Party (CHP), has been held at Marmara Prison in Silivri since his arrest in March 2025. Imamoglu emerged as the most prominent challenger to current President Recep Tayyip Erdogan before his arrest. Critics say his detention marked a broader crackdown on the CHP. (Photo by Burak Kara/Getty Images)
